claim_boundary: This receipt runs the complete accepted/trial/rollback vector arc-length loop to a negative-load branch on one analytic coupled two-DOF problem, using bound Engine v2 CPU FGMRES for every predictor and Schur-corrector tangent solve. It does not connect a frame/shell residual, cover a production model scale or sparse preconditioner, establish ROCm/HIP nonlinear parity, close full-load/full-mesh G1, or provide release-readiness evidence.
